title: Union Bank and Dulles in Nazi financing

tellings.quote: Um they I think Prescott Bush was, you know, president of the Union Bank and then Dulles was, you know, helping out with, you know, some Nazi financing.

plain: Michels says that the banker Prescott Bush was president of the Union Bank, and that Allen Dulles, who later ran America's main spy agency, helped with some Nazi financing. He says this tentatively, without a source, during an episode on UFO secrecy and secret societies. He brings it up to suggest that powerful American figures had ties to Nazi Germany.
